- PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN generated £2,773.43 revenue TW, the highest performing product, with 1,398 units sold and 41 orders.

- PLEASE ONE PERSON METAL SIGN showed strong WoW momentum with 3,286.4% revenue growth despite already being the top revenue generator TW.
- COOK WITH WINE METAL SIGN generated £1,415.04 revenue TW with 744 units sold and achieved 2,621.2% WoW growth.

- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS demonstrated strong YoY growth of 3,705.9%, indicating significant year-on-year performance improvement.
